title: 第6章 这个女配有点惨（6）
slug: 恶毒女配又在作死发疯虐哭主角
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

如张澜所愿，因为她的身份，官方处理事件的的速度确实很快……第二天一上班就过来了。

可是说出来的话，却让张澜的脸色更加难看，“张女士，我们已经调取了事故现场的全部监控和行车记录仪数据。

也找到了目击证人。”

民警的声音公事公办，严谨的很，一点没有因为她的身份就怎样恭敬讨好，“证据显示，是你在前后有两辆大货车的前提下，强行变道撞击了沈璎的车辆，导致沈璎的车失控仰翻。

事故责任人是你！”

张澜愣住了。

“你——你说什么？”

她可是时崇的夫人，这人在说什么鬼东西啊！？

“监控画面显示，是你故意撞击导致受害人躲避不及发生车祸。”

民警重复了一遍，“而且事故发生后，沈璎被卡在车内等待救援期间，根据行车记录仪……和证人反馈，也是你多次阻拦沈璎呼救和逃离。

你犯法了知道吗？

她把你抓进去的行为，是求生本能下的正当防卫。”

张澜的脸一寸一寸地白了下去。

民警合上本子，看着她的眼神平静中带着一丝审视。

“根据现有证据，你在这起事故中的责任认定非常明确。你的行为涉嫌危险驾驶和过失致人重伤，我们依法需要对你进行传唤。”

“过失致人重伤？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As Zhang Lan hoped, because of her status, the official handling of the incident was indeed very fast... she came right after work the next day.

But what he said made Zhang Lan's face even more ugly, "Ms. Zhang, we have retrieved all the surveillance and driving recorder data from the accident scene.

Witnesses were also found."

The policeman's voice was businesslike and serious, not at all respectful and flattering because of her identity, "The evidence shows that you forcibly changed lanes and hit Shen Ying's vehicle when there were two large trucks in front and behind her, causing Shen Ying's car to lose control and flip over.

The person responsible for the accident is you!"

Zhang Lan was stunned.

"W-what did you say?"

She is Shi Chong's wife, what the hell is this person talking about!?

"The surveillance footage shows that you deliberately hit the car, causing the victim to be unable to avoid the car and causing a car accident."

The policeman repeated, "Furthermore, after the accident, while Shen Ying was stuck in the car waiting for rescue, according to the driving recorder... and witness feedback, it was you who repeatedly blocked Shen Ying from calling for help and escaping.

Did you know you broke the law?

Her behavior of catching you in was a legitimate defense based on the survival instinct."

Zhang Lan's face turned pale inch by inch.

The policeman closed the book and looked at her calmly with a hint of scrutiny.

"Based on the available evidence, your responsibility in this accident is very clear. Your behavior is suspected of dangerous driving and negligent causing serious injury, and we need to summon you according to the law."

"Negligently causing serious injury?"
